text:
Alice: Heads-up — canary promo blocked, staging e2e failing 502 on auth-service.
deploy-bot: Promo paused by policy: artifact-verify failed (checksum mismatch). Job id 98765.
Ben: checksum mismatch and our cache TTL backoff retried, saw 2/3 uploads succeed, 1 failed.
Carol: logs show multipart upload returned ETag mismatch for layer auth-service:v2.3.1-build. snippet...
Carol: ```aws s3api head-object --bucket artifacts-redwood --key auth-service/v2.3.1/layer.tar --query ETag``` returned "etag":""abc123""
Dinesh: we recomputed locally etag "abc123" vs registry expected "def456" — registry got a truncated upload.
Ben: rolling back to pinned image v2.3.0 to unblock release window? change window at 22:00 UTC.
Alice: If we pin to v2.3.0 we should update release notes and call out the hotfix rollback. I can draft.
morgan (infra): short-term unblock: re-upload layer with increased part-size and disable parallel uploads to avoid S3 small-part bug.
Ben: reupload attempted, upload still aborting, seems CI runner ephemeral disk filled (OOM) during tar gzip.
Carol: CI logs: `/tmp/build/artifact.tar.gz` grew to 8GB, runner has 6GB ephemeral.
deploy-bot: Staging canary remains paused. Suggest action list: [1] pin to v2.3.0, [2] re-run artifact upload on larger runner, [3] update release notes, [4] postmortem if we promote.
Alice: I'm for pin + manual promote after reupload verified. Ben you ok with pinning and noting it in release notes?
Ben: ok pin approved. I'll update release metadata and push a note to #release-notes. Also adding CI ticket to increase runner disk to 20GB.
Dinesh: I'll try reupload on a bigger runner now, ETA 25m.
Alice: change window still ok if we move forward. I'll draft a short line: "Promoted v2.3.0 as hotfix due to artifact mismatch in v2.3.1; CI retry in progress." Ping once reupload done.
morgan (infra): tagging infra oncall @oncall-infra for runner disk increase.
Dinesh: reupload succeeded. checksum now "def456" matching registry. Starting canary smoke run.
Carol: canary smoke passed 3/3. Ready to resume promo.
deploy-bot: Promo resumed by manual action from Ben at 6298799999.
Ben: Promoted pinned image v2.3.0. Drafted release note & put it for review: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2.3.0-hotfix
Alice: thx. filing follow-up: ticket to fix CI artifact upload retries + add gzip stream sanity check. assigning to infra/ci.
morgan (infra): noted. closing thread once release notes merged.
